verdict.rationale: GitHub repo explicitly confirms Firecrawl is open source under AGPL-3.0 and can be self-hosted, with the cloud version at firecrawl.dev being an optional add-on with extra features, and community discussion (AGPL forking) corroborates this dual open-source/hosted model. Missing for 10: detailed self-hosting setup/deployment docs (Docker, infra requirements) and independent hands-on reports of running the self-hosted version successfully.
